body.description: Message data that needs to be processed.

issuerLifecycleId.description: This value is defined by the issuer to uniquely identify a transaction through its lifecycle.

matchedMessageId.description: Set to the message id of any matching message. The meaning of the matching message depends on the message being processed. A clearing message (financial advice) will contain the message ID of the original preauthorization. An incremental preauthorization will contain the message ID of the previous preauthorization. Reversals will contain the message ID of the message being reversed.

receivedDateTime.description: Datetime message was received from the network

messageType.description: General message type for the message. Preauthorizations do not contain sufficient information in order to affect a ledger balance while financial messages do. A preauthorization will typically be followed up by a financial message at a later time. Reversals can happen for either preauthorizations or financial messages.

messageUsage.description: Message Usage of the network transaction. A request will result in a response and an advice will result in an advice response. Advice messages cannot be declined.

debitCredit.description: Debit or Credit flag for the network transaction. Some categories such as balance inquiry and account inquiry are neither a debit nor a credit.

feeDetails.description: Details about the fees that went into the transaction and settlement fee amounts

application.description: Indicates whether the fee should be applied to a cardholder's account (SETTLE) or recorded for information purposes only (MEMO). Examples of MEMO fees are currency conversion fees (already in the settlement amount) and interchange fees.

settlementConversion.description:
- Contains settlement conversion rate information.
- This object will not exist on tokenization related messages.

date.description: This value represents the year, month, and day the conversion rate was determined.

factor.description:
This value represents the multiplying factor used to convert the transaction amount to the settlement
amount. This value can be used to calculate the conversion rate:

  conversion rate = conversion factor / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

or, to calculate the settlement amount:

  settlement amount = (transaction amount * conversion factor) / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

factorDecimalPosition.description:
This number represents the position the decimal point should be placed, starting from right. This can be
used to calculate the conversion rate:

  conversion rate = conversion factor / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

or, to calculate the settlement amount:

  settlement amount = (transaction amount * conversion factor) / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

transmissionDateTime.description: Network Transaction received Date and Time.

acquirerLifecycleId.description: This value is defined by the acquirer to uniquely identify a transaction through its lifecycle.

acquirerReferenceData.description: This value is a numeric string of data supplied by the acquirer in an acquirer-originated message.

encryptedKeys.description: An array of encrypted AES keys that will be decrypted using the appropriate private key

items.description: Encrypted DEKs, paired with public key Id they were encrypted with. All encrypted data in MessageRequest will be encrypted with same AES generated key. The key will be encrypted with multiple public keys, one for each of the services that can decrypt it.

publicKeyHash.description: Public key id in uuid format

clearingIdentificationCode.description:
This string represents the Acquiring Institution Identifier (also known as, AcquirerICA). This value
may be included with clearing messages.

authorizationLifeCycle.description: Optional data indicating that the acquirer or network has specified how long the funds should be held if approved. AFD messages typically have a very strict requirement on the lifecycle (often 2 hours). Downstream services from the Approval service will receive our expected hold period in this field.

replacementAmounts.description: All of these values are not required because we need to differentiate between a replacement amount of zero and no replacement amount at all.

feeDetails.description: Details about the fees that went into the transaction and settlement fee amounts

application.description: Indicates whether the fee should be applied to a cardholder's account (SETTLE) or recorded for information purposes only (MEMO). Examples of MEMO fees are currency conversion fees (already in the settlement amount) and interchange fees.

network.description: The network that we received the message on at Check Digit.

acquirerNetwork.description: The network on which the message was acquired.

interchange.description: Information on the general interchange group and optional network calculated amount of the interchange for this message. This is not always available and any amounts will be rarely accurate.

file.description:
This object includes data about the file used to derive the message when applicable. Messages sourced from a 
file are also known as offline messages.

fileIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for the file in which this message exists. Often will be the name of the file.

fileDescription.description: A description of the file whose usage depends on the type of file that was processed.

recordIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for this message in the processed file. Often this will be the record number.

fileDateTime.description: A timestamp associated with the whole file not the individual message.

addressVerificationData.description: Address data from the cardholder at the time of the purchase. Neither are required as only one may be supplied and there's no guarantee as to which one.

incremental.description: Indicator whether this has been identified by the acquirer as an incremental authorization or not.

lastClearing.description: Indicator whether this has been identified by the acquirer as the last clearing in a sequence or not.

recurring.description: Indicator whether this has been identified by the acquirer as a recurring transaction or not.

iiasData.description: Inventory Information Approval System data if available from the merchant. This is only available on some networks and only if the BIN has been enabled to receive this data.

merchantId.description: IIAS specific merchant ID which is different from the merchant name or card acceptor identification code

minimumTolerance.description:
The type of tolerance that should be applied if applicable. The tolerance may be prescribed by the network (in the case of prestigious properties) or downstream services from the Approval service will receive our expected tolerance.
A fixed amount indicates that the value supplied is the maximum amount that should be received in later clearing messages.
A percentage amount indicates the additional percentage above the total settlement amount that should be received in later clearing messages. This is a whole number (15 for 15%)

type.description: The type of tolerance that should be applied if applicable

tokenization.description: All relevant data relevant primarily the process of tokenization.

activationCode.description: The Activation Code to be distributed for tokenization.

tokenId.description: A unique id assigned by the party that initiated the tokenization.

tokenType.description: The type of token requested for this tokenization.

tokenRequestorId.description: The Id of the party that requested the tokenization.

oneOf.description: Text message to cardholder's mobile phone number. Value will be the cardholders's masked mobile phone number.
Email to cardholder's email address. Value will be the cardholder's masked email address.
Cardholder-initiated call to automated call center phone number. Value will be the phone number for the cardholder to call.
Cardholder-initiated call to customer support call center phone number. Value will be the phone number for the cardholder to call.
Cardholder to visit a website. Value will be the website URL
Cardholder to use a specific mobile app to activate token. Value will be replaced by a formatted string
Issuer-initiated voice call to cardholder's phone. Value will be the cardholder's masked voice call phone number

recommendedDecision.description: The decision recommended by the Wallet Provider.

deviceScore.description: Score given by the Wallet Provider on their confidence level of a particular property. Value always between 1 and 5.

accountScore.description: Score given by the Wallet Provider on their confidence level of a particular property. Value always between 1 and 5.

phoneNumberScore.description: Score given by the Wallet Provider on their confidence level of a particular property. Value always between 1 and 5.

recommendationReasons.description: Reasons provided to the Wallet Provider on how the recommended decision was reached.

tokens.description: Contains the Tokens which were updated.

tokenId.description: A unique Id assigned to a token.

tokenExpiration.description: The expiration date of the Token PAN given in MMYY format.

reasonCode.description: The reason code for why the notification is being sent. This applies to all tokens in the Tokens array.

activationCodeExpiration.description: The DateTime when the Activation Code is no longer valid.

numberOfActivationAttempts.description: The number of times an Activation Code was received to activate the token.

numberOfActiveTokens.description: The number of active tokens. Value might be differ from the number of tokens provided in the "tokens" property as this represents all active tokens, not just the ones whose status is being updated. Tokens that have been deleted from the wallet are excluded from the count.

tokenAuthentication.description: The indication on whether the given tokens have been authenticated.

tokenAssuranceLevel.description: A number that allows the token issuer to indicate the confidence level of the token on whether it belongs to the cardholder it claims to be associated with. Will only be present if tokenAuthentication = AUTHENTICATED

suspiciousEvent.description: The event for why the notification is being sent.

reason.description:
The reason why a suspiciousEvent is provided.

applicationTransactionCounter.description: Application transaction counter generated by the chip.

EMV 3-D Secure is a messaging protocol that enables consumers to authenticate themselves with their card issuer
when making card-not-present (CNP) e-commerce purchases. The additional security layer helps prevent unauthorized CNP
transactions and protects the merchant from exposure to CNP fraud.

proprietaryAuxiliaryData.description:
- Contains a list of client and/or card limits that were exceeded while processing this message. If no limits were exceeded, the arrays will be empty.
- Contains the bin to card limit currency conversion rate that was used when processing this message.

period.description:
DAY is a calendar day and will begin at 00:00:00 UTC.
WEEK is a calendar week and will begin on Mondays at 00:00:00 UTC.
MONTH is a calendar month and will begin on the first day of month at 00:00:00 UTC.
YEAR is a calendar year and will begin on the first day of the year at 00:00:00 UTC.
LIFETIME is a nonrecurring period that does not expire.
All periods are rolling if the associated periodLength is greater than 1

periodLength.description: How long the limit period lasts

limitFunction.description: AMOUNT functions by summing up the aggregate data point values.

value.description: The limits value. The value is expected to be in cents.

period.description:
DAY is a calendar day and will begin at 00:00:00 UTC.
MONTH is a calendar month and will begin on the first day of the month at 00:00:00 UTC.
All periods are rolling if the associated periodLength is greater than 1

periodLength.description: How long the limit period lasts

limitFunction.description: AMOUNT functions by summing up the aggregate data point values.

value.description: The limits value. The value is expected to be in cents.

binToLimitConversion.description:
Contains the conversion rate from the card's bin currency to the card's limit currency that was used when processing this message.
The value can be obtained in one of four ways and will be represented by the conversionSource field.

rate.description:
- The currency conversion rate information.
  To calculate the conversion rate:

    conversion rate = factor / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

  or, to calculate the target currency amount given a source currency amount:

    target currency amount = (source currency amount * conversion factor) / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

factor.description:
This value represents the multiplying factor used to convert a source currency amount to a target currency
amount. This value can be used to calculate the conversion rate.

factorDecimalPosition.description:
This number represents the position the decimal point should be placed, starting from the right. This can be
used to calculate the conversion rate.

effectiveOn.description: The date time that the conversion rate went into effect.

conversionSource.description:
- NONE
  - The card's limit currency matches the cards bin currency.
  - The rate will be 1.0
  - example scenario: BIN = USD, Card Limit Currency = USD, Transaction Currency = EUR
- NETWORK
  - The card's limit currency matches the message's transaction currency.
  - The rate will be the inverse of the settlementConversion data provided by the network
  - example scenario: BIN = USD, Card Limit Currency = EUR, Transaction Currency = EUR
- INTERNAL
  - The card's limit currency does not match the bin or transaction currency and a bin to limit currency conversion rate is defined within the Teampay Rate service at the time of the transaction.
  - The rate will be the bin to limit rate retreived from the Teampay Rate service at the time of the transaction.
  - example scenario: BIN = USD, Card Limit Currency = EUR, Transaction Currency = GBP, Rate from USD -> EUR is defined within Teampay Rate at the time of the transaction
- NOT FOUND
  - The limit currency does not match the bin or transaction currency and no bin to limit rate is defined within Teampay Rate at the time of the transaction.
  - The rate will be 0.0
  - example scenario: BIN = USD, Card Limit Currency = EUR, Transaction Currency = GBP, Rate from USD -> EUR is NOT defined within Teampay Rate at the time of the transaction
- NOT APPLICABLE
  - The incoming message's settlement amount is 0
  - The rate will be 0.0
  - example scenarios: tokenization messages, balance inquiries, 0 value transactions

- If the transaction was not declined or no further clarification is available, the array will be empty

messageUsage.description: Message Usage of the network transaction. A request will result in a response and an advice will result in an advice response. Advice messages cannot be declined.

debitCredit.description: Debit or Credit flag for the network transaction. Some categories such as balance inquiry and account inquiry are neither a debit nor a credit.

feeDetails.description: Details about the fees that went into the transaction and settlement fee amounts

application.description: Indicates whether the fee should be applied to a cardholder's account (SETTLE) or recorded for information purposes only (MEMO). Examples of MEMO fees are currency conversion fees (already in the settlement amount) and interchange fees.

settlementConversion.description:
- Contains settlement conversion rate information.
- This object will not exist on tokenization related messages.

date.description: This value represents the year, month, and day the conversion rate was determined.

factor.description:
This value represents the multiplying factor used to convert the transaction amount to the settlement
amount. This value can be used to calculate the conversion rate:

  conversion rate = conversion factor / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

or, to calculate the settlement amount:

  settlement amount = (transaction amount * conversion factor) / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

factorDecimalPosition.description:
This number represents the position the decimal point should be placed, starting from right. This can be
used to calculate the conversion rate:

  conversion rate = conversion factor / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

or, to calculate the settlement amount:

  settlement amount = (transaction amount * conversion factor) / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

transmissionDateTime.description: Network Transaction received Date and Time.

acquirerLifecycleId.description: This value is defined by the acquirer to uniquely identify a transaction through its lifecycle.

acquirerReferenceData.description: This value is a numeric string of data supplied by the acquirer in an acquirer-originated message.

encryptedKeys.description: An array of encrypted AES keys that will be decrypted using the appropriate private key

items.description: Encrypted DEKs, paired with public key Id they were encrypted with. All encrypted data in MessageRequest will be encrypted with same AES generated key. The key will be encrypted with multiple public keys, one for each of the services that can decrypt it.

publicKeyHash.description: Public key id in uuid format

clearingIdentificationCode.description:
This string represents the Acquiring Institution Identifier (also known as, AcquirerICA). This value
may be included with clearing messages.

authorizationLifeCycle.description: Optional data indicating that the acquirer or network has specified how long the funds should be held if approved. AFD messages typically have a very strict requirement on the lifecycle (often 2 hours). Downstream services from the Approval service will receive our expected hold period in this field.

replacementAmounts.description: All of these values are not required because we need to differentiate between a replacement amount of zero and no replacement amount at all.

feeDetails.description: Details about the fees that went into the transaction and settlement fee amounts

application.description: Indicates whether the fee should be applied to a cardholder's account (SETTLE) or recorded for information purposes only (MEMO). Examples of MEMO fees are currency conversion fees (already in the settlement amount) and interchange fees.

network.description: The network that we received the message on at Check Digit.

acquirerNetwork.description: The network on which the message was acquired.

interchange.description: Information on the general interchange group and optional network calculated amount of the interchange for this message. This is not always available and any amounts will be rarely accurate.

file.description:
This object includes data about the file used to derive the message when applicable. Messages sourced from a 
file are also known as offline messages.

fileIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for the file in which this message exists. Often will be the name of the file.

fileDescription.description: A description of the file whose usage depends on the type of file that was processed.

recordIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for this message in the processed file. Often this will be the record number.

fileDateTime.description: A timestamp associated with the whole file not the individual message.

addressVerificationData.description: Address data from the cardholder at the time of the purchase. Neither are required as only one may be supplied and there's no guarantee as to which one.

incremental.description: Indicator whether this has been identified by the acquirer as an incremental authorization or not.

lastClearing.description: Indicator whether this has been identified by the acquirer as the last clearing in a sequence or not.

recurring.description: Indicator whether this has been identified by the acquirer as a recurring transaction or not.

iiasData.description: Inventory Information Approval System data if available from the merchant. This is only available on some networks and only if the BIN has been enabled to receive this data.

merchantId.description: IIAS specific merchant ID which is different from the merchant name or card acceptor identification code

minimumTolerance.description:
The type of tolerance that should be applied if applicable. The tolerance may be prescribed by the network (in the case of prestigious properties) or downstream services from the Approval service will receive our expected tolerance.
A fixed amount indicates that the value supplied is the maximum amount that should be received in later clearing messages.
A percentage amount indicates the additional percentage above the total settlement amount that should be received in later clearing messages. This is a whole number (15 for 15%)

type.description: The type of tolerance that should be applied if applicable

tokenization.description: All relevant data relevant primarily the process of tokenization.

activationCode.description: The Activation Code to be distributed for tokenization.

tokenId.description: A unique id assigned by the party that initiated the tokenization.

tokenType.description: The type of token requested for this tokenization.

tokenRequestorId.description: The Id of the party that requested the tokenization.

oneOf.description: Text message to cardholder's mobile phone number. Value will be the cardholders's masked mobile phone number.
Email to cardholder's email address. Value will be the cardholder's masked email address.
Cardholder-initiated call to automated call center phone number. Value will be the phone number for the cardholder to call.
Cardholder-initiated call to customer support call center phone number. Value will be the phone number for the cardholder to call.
Cardholder to visit a website. Value will be the website URL
Cardholder to use a specific mobile app to activate token. Value will be replaced by a formatted string
Issuer-initiated voice call to cardholder's phone. Value will be the cardholder's masked voice call phone number

recommendedDecision.description: The decision recommended by the Wallet Provider.

deviceScore.description: Score given by the Wallet Provider on their confidence level of a particular property. Value always between 1 and 5.

accountScore.description: Score given by the Wallet Provider on their confidence level of a particular property. Value always between 1 and 5.

phoneNumberScore.description: Score given by the Wallet Provider on their confidence level of a particular property. Value always between 1 and 5.

recommendationReasons.description: Reasons provided to the Wallet Provider on how the recommended decision was reached.

tokens.description: Contains the Tokens which were updated.

tokenId.description: A unique Id assigned to a token.

tokenExpiration.description: The expiration date of the Token PAN given in MMYY format.

reasonCode.description: The reason code for why the notification is being sent. This applies to all tokens in the Tokens array.

activationCodeExpiration.description: The DateTime when the Activation Code is no longer valid.

numberOfActivationAttempts.description: The number of times an Activation Code was received to activate the token.

numberOfActiveTokens.description: The number of active tokens. Value might be differ from the number of tokens provided in the "tokens" property as this represents all active tokens, not just the ones whose status is being updated. Tokens that have been deleted from the wallet are excluded from the count.

tokenAuthentication.description: The indication on whether the given tokens have been authenticated.

tokenAssuranceLevel.description: A number that allows the token issuer to indicate the confidence level of the token on whether it belongs to the cardholder it claims to be associated with. Will only be present if tokenAuthentication = AUTHENTICATED

suspiciousEvent.description: The event for why the notification is being sent.

reason.description:
The reason why a suspiciousEvent is provided.
REPLENISH - There were suspicious ATC values reporting during Replenish.

applicationId.description: Application identifier that was used on the chip.

applicationTransactionCounter.description: Application transaction counter generated by the chip.

emv3DSecureData.description:
EMV 3-D Secure is a messaging protocol that enables consumers to authenticate themselves with their card issuer
when making card-not-present (CNP) e-commerce purchases. The additional security layer helps prevent unauthorized CNP
transactions and protects the merchant from exposure to CNP fraud.

network.description:
This value indicates the network used for the transaction. This value also serves as the discriminator
for the EMV3DSecureData object.

ucafCollectionIndicator.description:
This data describes the merchant support and issuer expectations 
regarding the Universal Cardholder Authentication Field (UCAF) and
whether Account Holder Authentication Value (AAV) data is present and authenticated.
enum: UCAF MUST BE PRESENT AND AAV AUTHENTICATED

universalCardholderAuthenticationField.description:
The Universal Cardholder Authentication Field (UCAF) is a data element that is used to convey
cardholder authentication data from the merchant to the issuer.

adviceResponse.description: An indication on why an advice message was received from the network.

responseCode.description: The response code sent back to the network for the merchant. Multiple declines reasons may exist but only one will be sent back to the network. Advice messages will include the response code that was sent on our behalf.
enum: ITEM SUBMITTED MORE THAN TWO TIMES

suppliedCardExpirationDate.description: A manually provided card expiration date, such as when entering card information into an online payment form. The date is assumed to be the last millisecond of the month.

repeat.description: This string indicates whether the incoming message is a repeat message.

SuppliedCardExpirationDate.description: A manually provided card expiration date, such as when entering card information into an online payment form. The date is assumed to be the last millisecond of the month.

maxAmount.description: Maximum amount that is applicable for the tag

debitCredit.description: Debit or Credit flag for the network transaction. Some categories such as balance inquiry and account inquiry are neither a debit nor a credit.

authorizationIdResponse.description: A 6 digit number that will appear on the cardholder's receipt and can be used as part of the matching logic for a message.

responseCode.description: The response code sent back to the network for the merchant. Multiple declines reasons may exist but only one will be sent back to the network. Advice messages will include the response code that was sent on our behalf.

declineReasons.description: All of the reasons why this message should be declined. An approval should result in an empty declineReasons array.

capture.description: Whether the card should be captured at the merchant or not.

enum: ADDRESS AND FULL POSTAL CODE MATCH

entryId.description: Unique identifier for any funds transfer that is created as a result of processing this message.

pendingAccounts.description: Pending state of accounts across an entire transaction. This goes beyond a single message and would give a snapshot of how much of a preauthorization still needs to be cleared.

debitCredit.description: Debit or Credit flag for the network transaction. Some categories such as balance inquiry and account inquiry are neither a debit nor a credit.

completedAccounts.description: Completed state of accounts across an entire transaction. This goes beyond a single message and would give a snapshot of how much a preauthorization or financial authorization has been cleared.

debitCredit.description: Debit or Credit flag for the network transaction. Some categories such as balance inquiry and account inquiry are neither a debit nor a credit.

holdExpirationDateTime.description: The UTC date time for when any pending holds will be removed for this message

tags.description: List of tags that were deemed appropriate for this message.

items.description: The tag that matches and any maximum amount usable for the tag. Most of the time this will be Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER but some IIAS data may dictate a maximum amount based on the type of merchandise being purchased.

maxAmount.description: Maximum amount that is applicable for the tag

activationMethods.description: The activation methods to be used for this tokenization. Returning an empty array will mean that no aditional activation methods are required to tokenize, with the except of any pre-configured with the party responsible for initializing the tokenization.

Email to cardholder's email address. Value will be the cardholder's masked email address.
Cardholder-initiated call to automated call center phone number. Value will be the phone number for the cardholder to call.
Cardholder-initiated call to customer support call center phone number. Value will be the phone number for the cardholder to call.

processedBy.description: The name of the service that provided the approval or decline

binToLimitConversion.description:
Contains the conversion rate from the card's bin currency to the card's limit currency that was used when processing this message.
The value can be obtained in one of four ways and will be represented by the conversionSource field.

rate.description:
- The currency conversion rate information.
  To calculate the conversion rate:

    conversion rate = factor / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

  or, to calculate the target currency amount given a source currency amount:

    target currency amount = (source currency amount * conversion factor) / (10 ^ factor decimal position)

factor.description:
This value represents the multiplying factor used to convert a source currency amount to a target currency
amount. This value can be used to calculate the conversion rate.

factorDecimalPosition.description:
This number represents the position the decimal point should be placed, starting from the right. This can be
used to calculate the conversion rate.

effectiveOn.description: The date time that the conversion rate went into effect.

conversionSource.description:
- NONE
  - The card's limit currency matches the cards bin currency.
  - The rate will be 1.0
  - example scenario: BIN = USD, Card Limit Currency = USD, Transaction Currency = EUR
- NETWORK
  - The card's limit currency matches the message's transaction currency.
  - The rate will be the inverse of the settlementConversion data provided by the network
  - example scenario: BIN = USD, Card Limit Currency = EUR, Transaction Currency = EUR
- INTERNAL
  - The card's limit currency does not match the bin or transaction currency and a bin to limit currency conversion rate is defined within the Teampay Rate service at the time of the transaction.
  - The rate will be the bin to limit rate retreived from the Teampay Rate service at the time of the transaction.
  - example scenario: BIN = USD, Card Limit Currency = EUR, Transaction Currency = GBP, Rate from USD -> EUR is defined within Teampay Rate at the time of the transaction
- NOT FOUND
  - The limit currency does not match the bin or transaction currency and no bin to limit rate is defined within Teampay Rate at the time of the transaction.
  - The rate will be 0.0
  - example scenario: BIN = USD, Card Limit Currency = EUR, Transaction Currency = GBP, Rate from USD -> EUR is NOT defined within Teampay Rate at the time of the transaction
- NOT APPLICABLE
  - The incoming message's settlement amount is 0
  - The rate will be 0.0
  - example scenarios: tokenization messages, balance inquiries, 0 value transactions
